name: FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE
source:
Congratulations, you've been accepted to the College of Magical Arts! Immerse yourself in a rich student life full of magic, passion, and adventure. Meet the eccentric residents of dorm 9 ¾ and get to know them as closely as you can...

[From [URL=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602290/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE]Steam[/URL]]
translation:
恭喜，你被魔法艺术学院录取了！投入充满魔法、激情与冒险的丰富校园生活。结识九又四分之三号宿舍里性情古怪的住客，和他们尽可能亲密地熟悉起来吧…
